class.name: IfcUnitaryEquipment
class.brief_description: Unitary equipment typically combine a number of components into a single product, such as air handlers, pre-packaged rooftop air-conditioning units, and split systems. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcUnitaryEquipment defines the occurrence of any unitary equipment; common information about unitary equipment types is handled by IfcUnitaryEquipmentType .
